intro: Exterior painting built for Texas — UV, humidity, clay-soil movement, and HOA palettes all handled by a local prep-first crew.

The Proud Paintbrush has repainted homes across Sugar Land, Katy, Richmond, Missouri City, and the rest of Fort Bend County since 2020. A Gulf Coast exterior takes a beating most regions never see: relentless summer sun on south- and west-facing walls, humidity that drives mildew into shaded brick and trim, and clay soil that shifts and stresses caulk lines and fascia every season. Paint alone does not solve that — the prep underneath does.
Every surface on your home has different needs, so we have a dedicated page for each. Find yours below for the specific prep, products, and approach we use.

process.title: Walk-Through & Estimate
process.desc: We assess your specific elevation, identify failure points, and put the full scope — color, product, prep, timeline — in writing.

process.title: Wash & Surface Prep
process.desc: Pressure wash to remove pollen and mildew, then scrape and sand failing coating back to a sound surface.

process.title: Repairs & Caulking
process.desc: Replace rotted trim and fascia, patch stucco cracks, and re-caulk every dynamic joint before any coating goes down.

process.title: Priming
process.desc: Spot-prime bare wood, stucco patches, and chalky surfaces individually so the topcoat bonds and lasts.

process.title: Application
process.desc: Gulf-Coast-rated coatings applied with the right technique, timed around heat and humidity to cure properly.

process.title: Final Walkthrough
process.desc: We walk the finished exterior with you and address anything before the job is considered done.

faqs.q: How much does exterior painting cost in Sugar Land?
faqs.a: It varies with home size, surface type, and the amount of prep and carpentry needed. See our exterior painting prices page, or book a free on-site estimate for exact numbers.

faqs.q: How long does an exterior paint job last here?
faqs.a: With proper prep and quality coatings, seven to ten years on Hardie and brick, and five to eight on stucco. South- and west-facing walls weather faster.

faqs.q: Do you handle HOA color approvals?
faqs.a: Yes. We are familiar with the approval processes across Fort Bend's master-planned communities and can prepare the color codes, specs, and photos boards typically require.

faqs.q: When is the best time to paint an exterior in Texas?
faqs.a: October through May is ideal — lower humidity and stable temperatures help coatings cure. We work year-round but plan summer projects carefully around the heat.

faqs.q: Do you repair rotted wood and stucco cracks before painting?
faqs.a: Yes. Carpentry repair and stucco crack repair are standard parts of our exterior projects, written into the estimate before we start.

faqs.q: Do you offer free exterior painting estimates?
faqs.a: Yes — every exterior estimate is free and on-site, with the color, products, prep, and price laid out in writing before we start. The Proud Paintbrush is fully insured.

faqs.q: How long does an exterior painting project take?
faqs.a: Most Fort Bend County exteriors take three to six working days depending on home size, surface type, and the amount of carpentry and prep involved. We give you a firm timeline in writing up front.
